multi_level_header.html_gap: A4 has header_rows and column_headers but no per-cell header_path; adapter required

column_period_binding.html_gap: A4 period_columns/cell period_start/period_end/period_semantics are compatible in meaning but use INSTANT/QUARTER/YTD/ANNUAL/UNKNOWN; PDF path uses point/duration plus normalized_period and does not by itself guarantee QUARTER versus YTD

quarter_ytd.evidence: A4 period_binding explicitly recognizes three/six/nine months and stores QUARTER/YTD; PDF shared axis recognizes point/duration and explicit period phrases but needs a conservative duration-to-project-semantic adapter

instant_duration.evidence: PDF point/duration axis and A4 INSTANT versus duration semantics can map without treating them as interchangeable

rowspan_colspan.evidence: table_html_parser.parse_table_html and A4 grid_rows expand spans

header_tree.evidence: metric_path_builder builds ordered row-parent paths; column headers are represented as per-cell header_path rather than a general tree object
